job.name: ig39_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still from a video podcast, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~66 с короткими седыми волосами в тёмной студии подкаста, микрофон, смотрит в камеру, губы приоткрыты, без надписей
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary older man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий подкаста ~66, седой, тёмно-синий пиджак, тёмная студия
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a high-end video podcast. A calm, self-assured Russian man about 66 with very short silver-grey hair, a lightly tanned weathered face with deep laugh lines, clean shaven, wearing a dark navy blazer over a crisp white open-collar shirt and a steel wristwatch. He sits relaxed in a dark moody studio, hands loosely together in front of him, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm to the side of his chest (not covering the mouth), looking straight into the camera, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, a faint knowing half-smile in the eyes, NO big smile. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: almost black studio with a soft warm rim light and a faint warm bokeh far behind. Rich cinematic contrast, real camera frame, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
